subject.title: tools.exec.approvalRunningNoticeMs is documented but rejected by the 2026.3.24 config schema

question: How should maintainers handle the open conflicting fork PR that claims the exact fix for this issue?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but an open non-maintainer-editable fork PR already closes the issue and prevents a clean duplicate repair recommendation without maintainer cleanup.

options.title: Adopt or replace the fork fix
options.body: Use the fork PR as source context, drop unrelated stale changes, and land a narrow schema-only fix in the target repository.

options.title: Ask the fork author to rebase
options.body: Leave this issue open while the contributor rebases and narrows the fork PR into a mergeable branch.

options.title: Close the fork candidate first
options.body: Close the conflicting fork PR as stale or unmergeable, then allow a fresh ClawSweeper or maintainer repair path.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace the fork fix
recommendation.body: Use the fork PR as source context, drop unrelated stale changes, and land a narrow schema-only fix in the target repository.

likelyOwner.reason: The original docs/config surface provenance points to this owner signal, and the decision is about accepting the canonical config shape rather than the old contributor branch.
